title: Task Result — Common Envelope
description: Standard return contract from a specialist agent to Queen. This envelope is validated before any role-specific extensions are examined.

contract_version.description: Must match the version from the corresponding task brief.

task_id.description: Must match the task_id from the dispatched brief.

agent.description: The specialist agent that performed the work.

status.description: succeeded = every success criterion satisfied. failed = task cannot complete. blocked = external dependency missing. changes_required = work done but criteria not fully met.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was done and what was found.

artifacts.description: Every file, dataset, or artifact produced.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence citations: source URLs, database queries, file line ranges, or artifact excerpts.

limitations.description: Known constraints, gaps, or unverified claims in this result.

errors.description: Errors encountered. Present means the task did not fully succeed.

recommended_next_step.description: What Queen should do next: route to another specialist, approve, or escalate.

description: Additional role-specific fields are allowed via extension schemas.
